guideline: Annotators rated Naturalness of turn-taking and Meaningfulness of dialogue content on a 5-point Likert scale (MOS protocol) after listening to prompt and continuation audio
Annotators listened to prompt and continuation audio and rated turn‑taking Naturalness (N‑MOS) and dialogue Meaningfulness (M‑MOS) on a 1‑5 Likert scale following the MOS protocol.
We adapt the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) protocol (a 5-pt Likert scale) (ITU-T Recommendation P.808, 2018) to evaluate Naturalness (N-MOS) of turn-taking and Meaningfulness (M-MOS) of dialogue content.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline descriptions into a single clear statement and normalized criteria to full descriptive names.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on spoken dialogue generation with synchronous LLMs. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy in dataset names and evaluation descriptions. The paper uses both automatic metrics (perplexity and correlation analysis) and human evaluation (MOS ratings) to assess dialogue quality.
